question: What becomes possible in the world when the guru is well pleased?
premises: Nothing is said to be impossible in this world.
This holds when the guru is well pleased.
inference: When the guru is well pleased, nothing in the world remains impossible.
uncertainties: guro may be read as vocative or as part of a locative construction with suprasanne.
plain_english: O sage, when the guru is well pleased, nothing in this world is impossible.
